Q: How to yield a reference to internally pinned data in a custom Stream implementation? (Lifetime mismatch with GATs)? A:

The Stream interface does not support yielding values bound to the life of the stream.

It has nothing to do with Pin. You can see the same problem with Iterator: Can I write an Iterator that mutates itself and then yields a reference into itself? (the answer is no). A lot of critical iterator patterns (like .collect()) wouldn't work with "lending iterators".

If you want this functionality, don't use a Stream - make your own interface.

Q: Access values associated with a generic type in TypeScript A:

The issue is that TypeScript type parameters are erased entirely at runtime, so `T` in `foo<T>()` produces no JavaScript and you cannot read values from it.

To answer your second question first: no, the TypeScript compiler will not emit `foo(Bar.foo)` or `foo(1)` when it sees `foo<Bar, 1>()`. Type arguments are hints to the type checker only. Q: anaconda navigator getting stuck at loading applications A:

There was an issue with proxy settings. It was solved. However there are some issues with anaconda navigator software. Its elements such as Spyder or ipython often fail to communicate with proxy properly particularly when there are credentials involved. As a result downloading datasets can often get involved.

I used this trick. I installed anaconda and configured the environment. Then I closed anaconda navigator window, launched Spyder/ipython from terminal and things always work for me.in case Spyder gives segmentation fault upon launch, simple downgrade the mkl package. The above tricks work like magic for me.

Q: Failed to initialize sqlcmd library with error number -2147467259 A:

Using a local temporary table generates this error. You can use temporary tables in DBMail, but they need to be global and not local tables, i.e. ##tmpa rather than #tmpa.
